dialogue.line: Uh, w-welcome fellas! We didn't ask for any "pizza", but... please, come in anyways!
Gawrsh, we hardly get any visitors here! Y'think they're tourists?
Come on guys, lets not turn away our guests!
S-sorry about that, we're not so used to new friends... l-lets start over, why don't we?
I'm Mickey Mouse, and welcome to my clubhouse!
Nice to meetcha Mickey! I'm Bruno Fernández, but you can call me BF.
Always a treat to meet a new pal!
Say, you seem like you know how to work with a microphone... interested in a musical number?
It's helped me get acquainted in the past, ha-ha!
...sure thing, Mickey! Don't expect me to go easy on you though!
Well, alright! Lets get this show on the road!
